# Bot test audio

`quality.wav` — 12 s, 48 kHz mono 16-bit PCM, generated by `generate.go`:

```powershell
cd tools/rostalkctl
go run testdata/generate.go
```

It is a deterministic synthetic signal (220/660/1320 Hz with a syllable
envelope), not recorded speech and not third-party music, so it can live in the
repository without a licence question. The 660 Hz carrier makes the bot easy to
find in a recording; the gaps and level changes expose dropouts and resampling
artefacts. The bot downmixes and resamples it to 8 kHz PCMU on the wire, so the
end-to-end test measures the client path, not this file's fidelity.

Used by `crates/voice/tests/media_integration.rs` with `rostalkctl bot --play
testdata/quality.wav --loop --duration 60s`. The plain tone (`--tone`) stays
for routing tests, where a single frequency is easier to detect.
